physical_connection.reason: City streets 1002/6783/23202 share municipal node 4993 at [-104.999734452924,39.7528550246765]; OSM ways 475723486/640085099 share node 3033992180, 1.897 m away. This establishes a plausible road-junction reference, not a drivable path from the precise designated pickup curb. No entry geometry adopted.

legal_motor_access.reason: City signs include loading-only, passenger-loading 7AM-5PM, reserved ADA and no-parking restrictions near the reference. Thirteen of 58 nearby sign records lack descriptions; selected restriction records were collected in 2022. An empty parking-restriction query is missing coverage, not unrestricted permission. Cannot establish current private-car pickup rights for an exact curb zone.

same_grade.reason: Independent municipal street data explicitly code all three road segments at Surface at both endpoints and share the same junction. This supports the road-road junction grade. It does not resolve the exact curb entry, bicycle lane crossing, barriers or a physical origin-to-road connector, so the full access question remains unknown.

direction_and_turns.reason: City metadata explicitly defines code 0 as Two Way for the three inspected segments; local OSM 17th is oneway=no. A no_left_turn relation 8877780 touches the selected Wynkoop way at a different node, 11952210822, toward way 905039434. The current routing model does not enforce all turn restrictions. Need entry/exit maneuver selection and current sign interpretation before a directional access finding.

connector_cost.reason: The 1.897 m city/OSM point disagreement is dataset displacement, not connector length. No route to the designated pickup curb has been selected; no zero-cost, straight-line or centroid connector is assigned.
